title: ze_save_nato_bunker_rn
description:
Fictional NATO Map Summary: 
 This is my first major map. This map, featuring high-quality defense zones, a large and expansive map, and action-packed escapes, is designed to provide players with a long-lasting and challenging experience. 

 Main Features: 
 Theme and Level: The map consists of two stages, with scenes taking place in areas such as the NATO Office and the Bunker. 

 Gameplay: 
 The main objective is to fight against zombies alongside 32 Alliance nations. Represent that nation by acquiring the pistol item. 

 Rules: 
 Flag Representation: Players must represent the automatically and randomly generated flags. 

 Don'ts: 
 Disrespecting flags. Engaging in political and policy discussions about NATO. Do not place labels on flags. 

www.gflclan.com
